nodes.name: ISOLATED TEST BRIDGE — REVIEW BEFORE IMPORT

parameters.content:
## Test-only native n8n bridge
Owner manually imports and publishes in factory-guard-test ONLY. No schedules or credentials. Loopback-only access. Fixed test control/effects table IDs. Fault requests run the three copied guard paths. Fixture endpoints modify/delete ONLY disposable test control rows on explicit operator requests; never connected to automatic error recovery. Unpublish after tests. See factory/tests/guard-bridge.md.
